items.name: Spanish Championship 2010

venue.name: [Centro Comercial Xanadú](http://www.madridxanadu.com)

items.information: Spanish Championship is open to all competitors from all countries. Registration is free but limited to a fixed number of competitors. So do not wait until the last minute. Registration will be closed on December 10.
